reasons.claim: Notified regeneration felling, 7.31 ha polygon in Lindesberg. No overlap with completed fellings, so not already felled.

Two eligible species within 250 m, both VU, site-bound and forest-associated, with 2024 records at 25 m uncertainty. The vascular plant Goodyera repens was recorded at 172 m (2 records); its listed threats include lack of dead wood and increased openness. The lichen Alectoria sarmentosa was recorded at 185 m (1 record); its listed threats include lack of continuity forest and old/large trees.

Three site-bound forest NT species were recorded within 250 m, all in 2024: Hydnellum ferrugineum at 6 m, Crossocalyx hellerianus at 16 m and Hermanssonia centrifuga at 135 m. They are supporting evidence only. NT birds (Poecile montanus, Picoides tridactylus) are mobile and supporting only.
Effort is above the county median (206 records vs 128.5; 61st percentile). Near-site, 19 records of 12 species were found within 250 m, plus 2 records of 1 species inside the polygon.

uncertainties: The eligible records are 172 m and 185 m from the polygon edge, so they may not lie in the stand to be felled.
The within-250 m records come from only 3 observation days, so they reflect a short recording effort.
The 2 records inside the polygon are of a single species that is not identified here.
not_established: Whether Goodyera repens or Alectoria sarmentosa occur inside the polygon today.
That the site is safe to fell.
Absence of other records does not show absence of other species.
next_action: Reviewer should check the 2024 Goodyera repens and Alectoria sarmentosa record locations against the polygon boundary. They should also check for old-forest and dead-wood features in the stand, and for other 2024 records of site-bound NT species at the edge.
